description: Source code for X509_ALGOR handling in OpenSSL, including functions for setting, getting, comparing algorithm identifiers, and related ASN.1 structures.

methods.name: X509_ALGOR_set0
methods.description: Sets the algorithm and parameters in an X509_ALGOR structure.

methods.name: X509_ALGOR_get0
methods.description: Retrieves the algorithm object, parameter type, and value from an X509_ALGOR structure.

methods.name: X509_ALGOR_set_md
methods.description: Initializes an X509_ALGOR with a message digest algorithm.

methods.name: X509_ALGOR_cmp
methods.description: Compares two X509_ALGOR structures for equality.
